tools.name: search_sleep_topics
tools.description: Search HealthySleep.ai's sleep disorder pages, sleep guides, CPAP therapy guides and sleep tools by keyword. Returns titles, short summaries, slugs and links. Use get_condition or get_guide with a slug for the full page and its sources.

tools.name: get_condition
tools.description: One sleep disorder page: summary, description, symptoms, causes, diagnosis, treatments, self care, when to see a doctor, FAQs and the sources it relies on (title and URL), with the site disclaimer.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One sleep guide or CPAP therapy guide: summary, sections, FAQs and the sources it relies on (title and URL), with the site disclaimer.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Everything HealthySleep.ai covers: sleep disorders by category, guides by category (including CPAP) and the sleep tools, with slugs.
